, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the official Swedish Royal Court website as “royals.se” and directed site-restricted searches there. This incorrect guidance led to repeated “no results,” wasted effort, and delayed using the correct official source (kungahuset.se) to confirm that Princess Madeleine is Prince Nicolas’s mother.
